# Colours by Pia Miriam

> Colours by Pia Miriam is the business of Pia Miriam, a London-based blonde and balayage specialist with over 14 years of experience. She started in 2010 at a salon on Kensington High Street, where she learned the Vidal Sassoon way of cutting, and became a colour specialist at an award-winning salon in Covent Garden. She colours hair one-on-one at the client's home, hotel or private space in London, and travels to clients in Madrid and Lisbon throughout the year.

Areas covered (North & West London): Hackney, Highbury, Islington, Camden, Belsize Park, Hampstead Heath, Kensal Rise, Brondesbury, Hampstead, Highgate, Primrose Hill, Kentish Town, Gospel Oak, West Hampstead, Dalston, Canonbury, Hackney Wick, Homerton, Stratford, St John's Wood, Maida Vale, Marylebone, Notting Hill, Holland Park, Kensington. Not south of the river.

## Services
- Colour consultation: Free
- Highlights · Half head: from £180
- Highlights · Full head: from £220
- Balayage · Half head: from £200
- Balayage · Full head: from £240
- Haircut: +£55
- Professional blow dry: +£40
- All colour services include a toner as well as a simple blow dry to complement the colour.
- Appointments outside London may have location-based pricing. Please get in touch for a personalised quote.

## Questions
- Do you come to my home? Yes. I colour hair one-on-one at your home, hotel or private space in London, and I bring everything needed.
- Where do you work? North and West London: Hackney, Highbury, Islington, Camden, Belsize Park, Hampstead Heath, Kensal Rise, Brondesbury, Hampstead, Highgate, Primrose Hill, Kentish Town, Gospel Oak, West Hampstead, Dalston, Canonbury, Hackney Wick, Homerton, Stratford, St John's Wood, Maida Vale, Marylebone, Notting Hill, Holland Park, Kensington. I don’t cover south of the river. I also travel to clients in Madrid and Lisbon throughout the year.
- How much does it cost? See Services above.
- Is the consultation free? Yes. Not sure which service is right for you? Let’s find your perfect colour together.
- What’s included? Every colour service includes a toner and a simple blow dry to complement the colour.
- How do I book? Use the booking form on this website, message me on Instagram or send me an email.
